screenshots.storyPurpose: Establish the enterprise token-waste problem and show that BuildWise forecasts the operating design and economics before implementation.
screenshots.caption: BuildWise moves AI cost management upstream—before deployment—by connecting workload design, deterministic routing, model choice, prompt budgets and governance.
screenshots.altText: BuildWise landing page showing the enterprise AI cost problem, a 100,000-interaction demonstration and a comparison between baseline and Balanced monthly design estimates.
screenshots.provenance: Protected release candidate; seeded demonstration economics; deterministic design estimate; no live provider result.

screenshots.storyPurpose: Show how a regulated pharmaceutical workflow separates deterministic controls from task-specific model assistance, editable routing and mandatory specialist review.
screenshots.caption: BuildWise decomposes the workflow before selecting models, keeping rules and validation deterministic while reserving model spend and human review for tasks that justify them.
screenshots.altText: Editable pharmaceutical adverse-event workflow showing deterministic tasks, task-specific models, fallback routes, token budgets and mandatory human-review controls.
screenshots.provenance: Protected release candidate; synthetic browser-local pharmaceutical project; deterministic calculation and demo catalogue routing; no live provider request.

screenshots.storyPurpose: Compare four inspectable operating policies and expose how model calls, token allowances, latency and governance choices produce different monthly costs.
screenshots.caption: Four inspectable operating policies reveal how task routing, context, retries, caching, fallback and review requirements change monthly AI cost.
screenshots.altText: BuildWise scenario comparison showing Baseline, Economy, Balanced and Assurance policies with calculated monthly cost, routing assumptions and budget status.
screenshots.provenance: Protected release candidate; synthetic browser-local pharmaceutical project; deterministic scenario estimate using demo catalogue pricing; no live provider result.

screenshots.storyPurpose: Demonstrate complete-request optimisation by balancing clearer instructions against context, output and retry reductions.
screenshots.caption: BuildWise evaluates instruction investment, retrieved context, output limits and retry reduction together to optimise the complete request—not just prompt length.
screenshots.altText: BuildWise prompt comparison displaying original and optimised pharmaceutical prompts with instruction, context, output, retry and net token differences.
screenshots.provenance: Protected release candidate; synthetic browser-local pharmaceutical project; deterministic token estimate; no live provider result.

screenshots.storyPurpose: Show the Hybrid implementation handoff, generated artifact navigation, export controls and a project-specific model-routing matrix preview.
screenshots.caption: The Build Kit turns the selected operating design into prompts, routing, cost forecasts, controls, evaluation plans and implementation guidance.
screenshots.altText: BuildWise Build Kit showing project-specific implementation artifacts, including routing, prompts, token forecasts, governance policies and GitHub Copilot handoff.
screenshots.provenance: Protected release candidate; synthetic browser-local pharmaceutical project; project-state artifact generation; credential-free export preview; no live provider request.
